stage0093a_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$甲児$$
「Is this the same space where I met $$ゼウス$$,
　when $$ハーデス$$ struck me down and I hovered
　between life and death...?」

stage0093a_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Very soon, Earth's people will become able
　to come here on their own strength...
　to a universe beyond time and space.」

stage0093a_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「I am waiting, you see.
　For the day when you... when Earth's people
　can come here by their own power.」

stage0093a_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「As I thought, you live in the age of the sun.」

stage0093a_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$甲児$$
「Those words... I've heard
　them a few times before」

stage0093a_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「The universe repeats death
　and rebirth, and within it,
　people evolve, little by little」

stage0093a_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Beast's blood, water's joining,
　wind's path, fire's civilization...
　Through these, people reach the sun's light」

stage0093a_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「And what awaits beyond that
　is the path to godhood」

stage0093a_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$甲児$$
「The path to godhood...
　What exactly is that?」

stage0093a_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「That's an answer you must
　seize with your own hands.
　Not something taught by another」

stage0093a_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$甲児$$
「What is it!
　Why do $$アドヴェント$$ and Supreme Commander $$不動$$
　both have to be so cagey about it!」

stage0093a_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「It's because the time has come
　for you, as living beings, to enter
　a new stage and touch the universe's truth」

stage0093a_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「By rights, we, as forerunners,
　are meant to watch over those
　who walk the path to higher life」

stage0093a_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「But the gods of Olympus forgot
　their duty, destroying others to
　become overlord of the universe itself」

stage0093a_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$甲児$$
「Where are they?
　$$ハーデス$$ should have appeared
　in Paradigm City to fight $$ミカゲ$$.」

stage0093a_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$甲児$$
「Both of them are our enemies.
　If they're going to fight, we'll cut right in.」

stage0093a_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Fighting $$ハーデス$$ with your own
　strength will be extremely difficult」

stage0093a_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$甲児$$
「If we don't fight, who'll
　protect people's peace
　and freedom...!」

stage0093a_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Those eyes... they hold what
　the gods of Olympus forgot」

stage0093a_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Love, courage, and justice...
　As I thought, you are the ones
　fit to inherit the power of light」

stage0093a_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「The task of stopping the
　gods' cruelty... I entrust it
　to you, along with my power」

stage0093a_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ゼウス$$
「Let's go, $$兜甲児$$.
　Believing that the light will fill the world once more.」

stage0093a_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「This is... $$ミカゲ$$'s maze of the heart...」

stage0093a_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You're saying this is inside $$ミカゲ$$'s heart...!?」

stage0093a_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「If I die, $$ミカゲ$$ won't be
　able to wield the Wings of the sun anymore...」

stage0093a_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm stupid, so...
　I can't think of any other way to stop $$ミカゲ$$.」

stage0093a_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「If $$ミコノ$$ is lost, $$アマタ$$ will grieve...
　I don't want $$アマタ$$ to be sad...」

stage0093a_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You... it'd be a waste to kill you over $$アマタ$$.」

stage0093a_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Let's go, Wreck!
　You and I both owe $$ミカゲ$$ plenty!」

stage0093a_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$カグラ$$
「This ain't the place to be hung up
　on someone like $$アマタ$$!!」

stage0093a_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Yeah!
　What I really need to do is fight!」

stage0093a_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Why...!
　Why was I defeated, and rejected by the Wings of the sun!?」

stage0093a_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Damn you...!
　I won't let this go unanswered!」

stage0093a_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$不動$$
「From 24,000 years ago...
　no, since 120,000,000 years ago, your hatred endures...」

stage0093a_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Shut up! Shut up, shut up, shut up!!
　I won't forgive it!
　Not you, not the wing dog... nor them, either!!」

stage0093a_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「My hatred will only grow fiercer!
　Even if the 120,000,000-year ring of fate closes!!」

stage0093a_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$不動$$
「That hatred... is bottomless, is it...」
